data.name: EnableHint
data.value: Follow the foreground Microsoft Word document and save ink per page.

data.name: ScopeHint
data.value: Supports Microsoft Word print layout with one pane. WPS Writer requires compatible automation and accessibility interfaces. Uses WPF ink; verify annotation versions and positions after editing text or layout.

data.name: StorageHint
data.value: Annotations are stored separately under WordAnnotations in the application folder. Word files are not modified. Input is paused during connection, save failures or uncertain page positioning.

data.name: Timeout
data.value: Word is not responding; annotations paused

data.name: Busy
data.value: Word is busy; annotations paused and will resume automatically

data.name: HelperMissing
data.value: Word link helper is missing. Replace the complete application folder and restart.

data.name: HelperMismatch
data.value: Word link helper version mismatch. Replace the complete application folder and restart.

data.name: PrintLayoutRequired
data.value: Use Word Print Layout with a single pane

data.name: Locating
data.value: Locating pages; bring document content into view

data.name: LayoutChanged
data.value: Document content or pagination changed. Previous annotations are preserved; confirm to continue with the new layout.

data.name: LoadFailed
data.value: Annotations could not be loaded; input paused to preserve existing data

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: Annotations could not be saved; check folder permissions and disk space

data.name: UsePptAppearanceHint
data.value: Use the colors, page numbers, size, opacity and shadow of the corresponding PowerPoint navigation controls.

data.name: ShowZoom
data.value: Show document zoom on the right

data.name: FollowWindowHint
data.value: When off, anchor navigation to the bottom corners of the current canvas.

data.name: AutoEnterFocusModeHint
data.value: Enter Focus after connecting. Manually exiting prevents automatic re-entry for that document.

data.name: HistoryConfirm
data.value: Restore this annotation version? Current annotations will be backed up and the historical file kept. Text or layout may have changed; verify annotation positions after restoring.

data.name: WpsUnavailable
data.value: This WPS window does not expose a usable automation interface or document viewport. Open a local WPS Writer document and check that automation components are available.

data.name: HistoryFailed
data.value: Annotation history could not be restored. The original history file is preserved. Check storage permissions and logs.
